name: Ningbo Zhongda Leader Intelligent Transmission
name_zh: 宁波中大力德智能传动股份有限公司
summary: Ningbo Zhongda Leader Intelligent Transmission develops and manufactures motor drives, geared motors, precision reducers and integrated motion units. Its range serves industrial automation, logistics and robotics; the planetary-reducer families listed here are components rather than complete robots.
